item.title: GitMorning 0.5.7
item.description:
GitMorning 0.5.7 — Cleaner settings and one-line install
- Simpler screens: Settings, project details, the README preview, and the morning brief drop explanations the controls already show. - Settings now has four tabs. The Data tab is gone; a custom feed can still be set with `defaults write dev.gitmorning.prototype feedBaseURL https://…`. - Aligned text: settings notes and the README preview now line up on the left. - One-line install: `brew install --cask ddingddong9/apps/gitmorning`. Homebrew installs open without the first-launch block. - Bundled Trending lists refreshed.
설정·상세 화면의 부가 설명 정리 · 설정 탭 4개로 간소화(데이터 탭 제거) · 텍스트 정렬 수정 · Homebrew 한 줄 설치, 첫 실행 경고 없음
Apple Silicon · macOS 14+. Not Apple-notarized: Homebrew installs open normally; if you download the ZIP, approve the first launch in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
